Evidence to collect: Usage and adoption notes tied to the approved pilot objective
Owner question: Did the pilot produce decision-useful evidence rather than demo excitement?
Green signal: Measured user behavior and owner feedback are documented
Stop/escalate signal: No named owner can explain whether the pilot helped the intended workflow

Evidence to collect: Incidents near-misses human overrides and unresolved limitations
Owner question: What failed or almost failed in the first 30 days?
Green signal: Known failures have owners mitigations and rollback path
Stop/escalate signal: Failures are hidden in chat threads or vendor dashboards only

Evidence to collect: Cloud LLM GPU integration and support cost log
Owner question: What did actual run cost suggest before scale?
Green signal: Cost drivers and scale assumptions are visible to finance
Stop/escalate signal: Run cost is unknown or materially above approval assumptions

Evidence to collect: Data classes access changes audit logs and retention exceptions
Owner question: Did new users data routes or integrations appear after launch?
Green signal: Access/data changes are reviewed against approval scope
Stop/escalate signal: Shadow data use or unmanaged access appeared after go-live

Evidence to collect: Support tickets runbook gaps SLA misses and monitoring ownership
Owner question: Can operations support this without the pilot team?
Green signal: Runbook gaps and support owners are named
Stop/escalate signal: Production support depends on one developer or unmanaged vendor help

Evidence to collect: Marketing sales customer-facing wording and proof boundaries
Owner question: Are we making claims beyond the evidence?
Green signal: External claims match measured scope and limitations
Stop/escalate signal: ROI accuracy compliance certification or customer-result claims exceed evidence

Evidence to collect: 30-day review meeting notes decision owner and next gate
Owner question: Should the system continue expand pause or roll back?
Green signal: Leadership decision and next review date are recorded
Stop/escalate signal: Expansion happens without a decision record or owner sign-off
